entries.cb63cc5c484f61ea: Its strengths are its property assessment expertise, built up as a party that leases store properties itself and then lends them out, and its property management know-how for reducing problems such as water leaks and odors. The number of members of the ijinuki property information site “Ijinuki Tenpo.com” reached 118,235 as of the end of March 2026, supporting matching with prospective store operators.
